Function Name: is_equal_to_sum_even  
Description: Determines whether a given positive integer n can be expressed as the sum of exactly four positive even integers.  
Parameters:  
- n (integer): The number to test. Must be a positive integer.  
Example Usage:  
- is_equal_to_sum_even(20) → True  
  (because 20 = 2 + 4 + 6 + 8)  
- is_equal_to_sum_even(14) → True  
  (because 14 = 2 + 2 + 4 + 6)  
- is_equal_to_sum_even(7) → False  
  (cannot represent 7 as sum of four positive evens)
